selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a bookcase and not a similar shelving unit or cabinet, verifying class alignment.
To ensure the bookcase sits correctly on the floor/against the wall without geometric melting or perspective distortion common in AI generations.
AI often struggles with the complex topology of many thin, parallel objects (book spines). This expert will check for fused spines or irregular boundaries.
To assess overall image quality, noise, and potential subtle artifacts in textures or lighting.

focus_areas: Straightness of vertical and horizontal lines (structural rigidity)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the book spines. In AI images, these often blur together or have nonsensical text. Verify if the text on book spines is legible or gibberish. Check if the vertical lines of the bookcase are perfectly straight or if they wobble/bend, which would indicate structural instability. Ensure the shadow cast by the bookcase on the wall is consistent with the lighting source.
